name: english-quest
description: Private two-person study platform for reaching CEFR C1 in English

scripts.api: docker compose exec api pnpm dev
scripts.web: docker compose exec web pnpm dev
scripts.install:all: docker compose exec api pnpm install
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api pnpm db:seed
scripts.content:import: docker compose exec -w /workspace/apps/api api pnpm content:import
scripts.content:stats: docker compose exec -w /workspace/apps/api api pnpm content:stats
scripts.content:generate: docker compose exec -w /workspace/apps/api api pnpm content:generate
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src apps/web/test apps/web/e2e apps/web/playwright.config.ts packages/shared/src packages/design-tokens/src packages/design-tokens/test --max-warnings 0
